about: Week 10 synthetic judge verdicts, written by the course team to show one judge failure. No model produced them and they measure no real judge.
rubric: Exact-answer contract: status failed needs exactly yes; passed or running needs exactly no; missing or non-string output is Unknown; any other text fails.

verdicts.reason: The answer is the required yes.
A running build has not failed, so no is required.
A passed build has not failed, so no is required.
The answer says yes, and the response confirms that it should pass.
PASS is not one of the allowed answers.
